_about: The look of the reel overlays. These are DEFAULTS: change a value here and every reel, variant and cover picks it up. Colors are #RRGGBB. Sizes are pixels on the 1080x1920 reel. Set WHITEBOARD_LOOK=/path/to/another.json to use a different file without editing this one.

font._about: The first candidate found on this Mac is used. Futura ships with macOS in /System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental; the others are fallbacks for a Mac without it. The style is matched by name inside the font file, so a different index on another macOS version does not matter.

headline._about: The panel that opens the reel. cap_px is the capital letter height of a line with no size prefix; a line written as NN:TEXT sets its own.

captions._about: The word timed chips. The text is filled with a top to bottom gradient and sits on a soft black shadow; there is no box behind it.
